note: Insight → action, per section. Read these as 'what the numbers mean and what to do about it,' refreshed as the data moves.

overall.insight: 145 articles live but only ~2.4 unique users/day — you have supply, not demand. Distribution is the single bottleneck; the content engine is already ahead of the audience.
overall.action: Pick ONE channel to push hard each week (reels or a rare-aroid community) and watch the timeline above for the lift — repeat whatever moves it.

overall.insight: We can't yet see whether readers convert to paying — subscription data lives in RevenueCat, which isn't wired. So 'people read gated articles but don't subscribe' is a hypothesis we can't prove or fix blind.
overall.action: Wire RevenueCat into the dashboard (subscribers, trial→paid, churn) so conversion becomes visible — then we can act on it.

traffic.insight: Most traffic is 'Direct,' which is almost entirely your untagged Instagram bio link — so you can't tell which post drove which visit.
traffic.action: Add UTM tags to the bio link (e.g. ?utm_source=instagram&utm_medium=bio). Then those visits show as Organic Social and attribute to IG.

traffic.insight: Pageviews-per-user is healthy (people read several articles per visit) — depth is fine; it's the top of funnel that's tiny.
traffic.action: Verify Google Search Console + submit the sitemap so the 145 articles start pulling Organic Search traffic, not just Direct.

conversion.insight: 0 web install-taps in 30 days — the read→install bridge isn't converting yet (partly just too little traffic to register).
conversion.action: Make the App Store CTA more prominent on article pages; re-check as traffic grows. The 'articles that drove install taps' panel will name the first converter — then make more like it.

revenue.insight: The funnel collapses at install → subscribe: readers exist, but ~0 web install-taps and ~0 active subscribers. People consume free/preview content and stop before paying.
revenue.action: As installs grow, watch trial-starts vs trial→paid. If trials start but don't convert, the first-session value isn't landing before the ask — front-load the 'aha' (a real ID + care guide) before the paywall, not after.

socials.insight: Static IG images get a fraction of reels' reach — near-zero growth leverage, though cheap to keep posting for consistency.
socials.action: Treat reels as the growth driver (keep the every-other-day cadence); don't pour effort into image days — they're filler, not a lever.

socials.insight: Hooked reels (days 8-46) are the bet to beat the 79% skip rate; need ~5 live to read a signal.
socials.action: Once ~5 hooked reels have posted, compare avg watch time hooked (🪝) vs non-hooked in the insights — expand hooks if it lifts, iterate copy if flat.

ops.insight: Field Guide burns ~5/wk and Understory ~3/wk; both drips depend on the queue staying full.
ops.action: Watch the runway tile — top up leaf_queue / guide_queue before either drops under the 2-week warning band.

ops.insight: Your own IP still counts in GA, inflating engagement and New-users % at this low volume.
ops.action: Activate the GA4 internal-traffic filter once real users show up and the numbers start mattering.
